note: Sizes are generation parameters, not measurements. Results are recorded on run to benches/results/*.jsonl.
git_layouts: normal clone with main branch + origin remote
rss_method: peak_rss_bytes via getrusage(RUSAGE_SELF): macOS ru_maxrss is bytes, Linux is kilobytes (normalized in benches/support.rs)
sampling: 1 Hz resource telemetry per spec section 5; per-phase peak RSS recorded in JSONL
warmup: cold pass then warm pass over identical scope; sustained 30s PERF-02 runs repeat the controlled fixture
